# §8.2 atomic transaction. Counters that already exist are not recreated (§10.7).
add table inet fvpn
flush set inet fvpn allowed_v4
add element inet fvpn allowed_v4 { 100.64.1.1 timeout 3599871ms, 100.64.1.2 timeout 3599871ms, 100.64.2.1 timeout 3599871ms }
flush set inet fvpn denied_v4

flush set inet fvpn resolver_v4
add element inet fvpn resolver_v4 { 198.51.100.53 }
delete chain inet fvpn forward
add chain inet fvpn forward { type filter hook forward priority -150; policy drop; }

add chain inet fvpn input { type filter hook input priority -150; policy accept; }

# §8.2 atomic transaction. Counters that already exist are not recreated (§10.7).
add table inet fvpn

add element inet fvpn allowed_v4 { 100.64.1.1 timeout 3599867ms, 100.64.1.2 timeout 3599867ms, 100.64.2.1 timeout 3599867ms }
flush set inet fvpn denied_v4
add element inet fvpn denied_v4 { 0.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8, 100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12, 192.0.0.0/24, 192.0.2.0/24, 192.0.2.200/32, 192.168.0.0/16, 192.88.99.0/24, 198.18.0.0/15, 198.51.100.0/24, 224.0.0.0/4, 240.0.0.0/4, 255.255.255.255/32 }

flush set inet fvpn resolver_v4
add element inet fvpn resolver_v4 { 198.51.100.53 }
delete chain inet fvpn forward
add chain inet fvpn forward { type filter hook forward priority -150; policy drop; }

delete chain inet fvpn output
